title: fix(plugin-form,fields): line-item grids read boolean options and file text in the session language (objectui#12924)
body:
Fixes #12924

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Under a zh-CN session a line-items grid drew two English literals: the two options of a column derived from a `boolean` / `toggle` child field (`Yes` / `No`, from `optionsFor` in `packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`), and a file cell's text (`N files` / `File`, from `GridField`'s `displayText`). Both now read the language packs. English reads as before, and the stored values `'true'` / `'false'` are unchanged (display only, per triage `6242616353`).

## What changed

### Boolean options: the existing `common.yes` / `common.no`

The labels come from `useBooleanValueLabel` (`@object-ui/fields`), the one rule that names a boolean value as a word. It is the read-only boolean precedent from objectui#11689 (merge `22b503c30`), which chose `common.yes` / `common.no` over `grid.yes` / `grid.no` (ObjectGrid's toolbar bundle) and `lookup.yes` (no `no` half). No second boolean vocabulary and no key were added.

`deriveMasterDetail.ts` is pure and has no translator, so the hook is called by its two producers and handed in:

| Producer | Call | How the words stay current |
|---|---|---|
| `LineItemsPanel` (`record:line_items`) | `hydrateColumns(columns, childSchema, { booleanLabel })` inside the grid `useMemo` | the memo is keyed on the two WORDS (`booleanLabel(true)` / `booleanLabel(false)`), not on the function, which is a new one every render (AGENTS.md rule 10); a live language switch re-labels the picker |
| `MasterDetailForm` | `deriveDetail(..., { booleanLabel: booleanLabelRef.current, ... })` inside the resolve effect | read through a ref when the child schema arrives; NOT an effect dependency, because re-running that effect re-resolves every entry and a new `resolvedEntries` re-reads the lines over unsaved edits (see Acceptance notes) |

### The shape chosen: `booleanLabel` is REQUIRED on every derive function

`deriveColumns(childSchema, { booleanLabel, ... })`, `hydrateColumns(columns, childSchema, { booleanLabel })` and `deriveDetail(childObject, childSchema, parentObjectName, { booleanLabel, ... })`. There is no default and no `??` fallback. Callers measured first: two production callers (above), zero outside `packages/plugin-form` in objectui, zero in objectstack (`git grep` over both trees). The four axes:

- **Real business need:** the only real producers are the two carriers above. The no-translator call form has no caller outside this package's own tests.
- **Long-term fit:** contract-first (AGENTS.md rule 0.1). The pure module never holds a word of its own.
- **Hard for an AI to get wrong:** a new caller that forgets the translator is a compile error, not a grid that silently draws English under zh. An optional parameter with an English default would bring back exactly this defect class, unseen.
- **No spreading:** no default kept for hypothetical external callers. The break is stated in the changeset.

Cost: a breaking type change on two published exports, so `@object-ui/plugin-form` is `minor` with the breaking semantics in the changeset, and 46 existing test call sites in six plugin-form test files are threaded mechanically. The plugin-form README and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx` document it.

### File text: the existing `detail.fileCount` family and `fields.file.fileFallback`

- Several files: `t('detail.fileCount', { count })`, the count family `FileCellRenderer` already uses. Every pack carries every CLDR slot its language selects: `ru` has `_one` / `_few` / `_many` / `_other`, `ar` has all six, and `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` owns that rule.
- A nameless file: `t('fields.file.fileFallback')`, the name `FileField` and `FileCellRenderer` already give it.
- The module helper is now `cellDisplayText(c, value, locale, fileText, currency)`. `GridFieldBody` binds the words once as a local `displayText` with the old four-argument shape, so every call site, including the read-only table line objectui#12923 owns, calls it unchanged. This is the same one formatter, not a second one. Inline `defaultValue`s are the `en` values (held by `pnpm check:i18n-keys`), so a provider-less grid reads `2 files` / `File` byte for byte.

### Sibling objectui#12923 (merged)

It landed on main as `8523e81db` while this branch was in flight. The branch merged `origin/main` (merge `45e30586e`, no rebase, no force-push), with no conflict: the read-only cell's `displayText(c, row[c.name], displayLocale, currency)` binds to the local above. The read-only table is now pinned too (below).

## Measured: no new language-pack key

Mechanism assumption 3 does not hold. An existing counted key with its full plural family, `detail.fileCount`, already covers the file count, and existing keys cover the other three words. So no pack changed and `@object-ui/i18n`'s public surface did not move. The claim's first write read `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the premise of a new key; the seat amended the claim and this body to `no (narrowing)` at review, the measured reading under Deviations.

## Tests

New pins. Every oracle is read from the pack, and `Intl.PluralRules` names the slot:

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.fileCellText-12924.test.tsx`: zh list-mode cell, zh read-only table, ru `few` (2) / `many` (5), en control, named-file control. 5 passed.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.fileCellText-12924.no-provider.test.tsx`: `2 files` / `File` with no provider, list and read-only. 2 passed.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.booleanOptions-12924.test.tsx`: the three derive functions draw with the handed function and keep `'true'` / `'false'` (boolean and toggle), plus a select control. `record:line_items` under zh: the editable picker, the read-only table (after objectui#12923), and a live en-to-zh switch. `MasterDetailForm` under zh: the editable grid and list mode. 9 passed.

Ablations, run after the fix was committed, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with an anchor that must hit. Every restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`:

- **A.** `cellDisplayText`'s file branch back to `` `${files.length} files` `` / `'File'`: 3 red (zh list, zh table, ru), 4 green (en, named control, both no-provider). The diff shows `2 个文件` / `文件` turned into `2 files` / `File`.
- **B.** `optionsFor` labels back to `'Yes'` / `'No'`: 6 red, 1 green (the select control). Re-run against the read-only-table pin: red (`是` / `否` turned into `Yes` / `No`).
- **C.** The `LineItemsPanel` memo without the two word deps. The first run, against the zh-at-mount pin, stayed GREEN: the memo recomputes when the child schema lands after the catalogue, so that pin does not measure the keying. The run was re-pointed at the new live-switch pin, which turned RED.

Suites, local, at `a0fd1e4b9` (the head after the merge; `18e828ee4` only re-types one helper in the file-text pin, which re-ran green after that edit):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/`: 126 files, 1144 passed.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/`: 191 files in three runs to fit the 10-minute foreground cap (the `__tests__/` directory, then the top-level files in two halves): 65 files / 755 passed + 1 skipped; 59 / 355; 67 / 1210.
- `packages/i18n/`: 83 files, 1325 passed + 13 skipped.
- Type-check (each script echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) at `18e828ee4`: `@object-ui/fields` 0, `@object-ui/plugin-form` 0, `@object-ui/i18n` 0. Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build`: 0.

## Gates (local, at `18e828ee4`, exit codes captured before any pipe)

| Gate | Exit | Verdict line |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm check:i18n-keys` | 0 | every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack, every literal inline defaultValue matches |
| `pnpm check:i18n-drift` | 0 | No en value changed in this range |
| `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` | 0 | report only |
| `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity` | 0 | every en row has a zh row |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | 0 new citation(s) |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | OK |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | 13 source files of 2 released packages changed, 1 changeset declared |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | 0 | no new `major` |
| `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues` | 2 | NOT MEASURED: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no `apps/console/dist`; this change adds no catalogue import to source). CI's `performance-budget.yml` runs it on a build |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (16 paths) | 0 | NOT GOVERNED |

Lint, the full test matrix and the rest of the farm are CI's.

## Deviations from the dispatch

1. **File surface widened** past the claim, for the threading the dispatch's mechanism assumption 1 anticipated. Added: `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and `LineItemsPanel.tsx` (the hook-holding producers); six existing plugin-form test files (the required parameter, mechanical); `packages/plugin-form/README.md` and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx` (AGENTS.md rule 2). In `GridField.tsx`, the helper rename and the local binding go one step past "displayText's text only". That step is what keeps the read-only routing untouched.
2. **Clause-②:** the line above is the claim's, copied. Measured, there is no widening: no key was added, and `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/fields` have unchanged public surfaces. `@object-ui/plugin-form`'s `deriveDetail` / `deriveColumns` now REQUIRE a member, which narrows accepted calls (breaking). The measured reading is `no (narrowing)`, for the seat to amend.
3. **Changeset:** `@object-ui/plugin-form: minor` (breaking public signature, this repo's convention), not `patch`; `@object-ui/fields: patch`; no `@object-ui/i18n` entry, since nothing in it changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Late catalogue, `MasterDetailForm` (patch round 2):** the derived boolean words are no longer taken once. The resolve effect keeps each entry's column derivation re-runnable, and the line grids draw it at render, keyed on the two words, so a catalogue that lands after the child schema (a host that does not await `preloadBootstrapLocale`) or a language switch re-labels the options. The effect does not re-run and the lines are not re-read: an unsaved edit survives. Pinned by `MasterDetailForm.lateCatalogue-12924.test.tsx`: red before the fix, green after, red again under ablation. Carrier: this PR.
- The boolean-options `MasterDetailForm` pins load the zh catalogue before mounting, as that preload does. The late-catalogue pin holds it back instead, with its own instance and a gated registry load. The `LineItemsPanel` pins exercise the lazy path and the live switch.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01N3thnWhtvLywz5ECCWAb7p` (os-dev dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 3; branch `claude/issue-12924-line-items-i18n-literals`).
